parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The feature alias. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: Additional filter conditions in a JSON object. Conditions are combined by using the AND operator.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The feature name. Fuzzy search is supported.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: Specifies the sort order. Valid values: `Asc` and `Desc`.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of features to return per page.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field used to sort the returned features.
